boundary: All raw GPU kernels, memcpy and memset intersecting each declared layer window; intervals clipped to the window only for unions. CUDA APIs overlapping gaps are descriptive and do not establish causality or removable unprofiled overhead.
compute_boundary: Projection, index, top-k, attention and finish kernels. Auxiliary/cache work and fused ECHO indexer/prefetch are excluded from the separate compute-gather overlap because fused internal intervals are unknown.
